diagnosis.cause: Node.js 26 no longer ships corepack, so `corepack enable` (the prior repair) fails with exit 127; the correct way to install yarn is shown in `.github/workflows/package-manager-ci.yml` lines 72–73: `curl -o- -L https://yarnpkg.com/install.sh | bash`.

doc.text: Before running `yarn` or `yarn test`, install Yarn via its classic installer (corepack is not available in Node.js 26): `curl -o- -L https://yarnpkg.com/install.sh | bash && export PATH="$HOME/.yarn/bin:$HOME/.config/yarn/global/node_modules/.bin:$PATH"`
